context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 service splash screens now use unified ServiceSplash component. Routes: /home-care (home-care-splash → home-care-services), /medicine-reminders (med-reminder-splash → login prompt or med-reminder-main), /evercare (evercare-splash → evercare-main), /adult-vaccination (vaccination-splash → vaccine listing). Each splash has: floating 3D image (splash-hero-image), glassmorphism card container, bold caption (splash-caption), description (splash-description), gradient Get Started button (splash-get-started), dot indicators. Home page 2x2 grid cards: home-home-care, home-medicine-reminders, home-evercare, home-vaccination. ServiceSplash component accepts props: image, imageAlt, caption, description, buttonLabel, buttonGradient, bgGradient, accentColor, onContinue, testId.
